bullets.title: Lapsang Souchong tea
bullets.note:
\-- I was inspired by Malcolm Gladwell to jump back on the Lapsang train, as
[it’s one of his favorite
teas](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wW8&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=p&).
To many, this tea smells and even tastes like smoky, peaty whisky. One of my
dear friends swears it helps him abstain from alcohol. Definitely worth a sip
or twenty.
